Package com.tonic.analysis.cpg.edge

Class CPGEdge

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.tonic.analysis.cpg.edge.CPGEdge
  • public class CPGEdge
extends Object
    Directed, typed edge between two CPG nodes; identity is (source id, target id, type).
